children: none, because the split is one sieve plus one declaration-field extension to an existing set (cairn/machines/corrosion/constraint_set.json), both inside one component's address — /chart's decompose stage at /sail step 0 is where this splits into pieces, and a child ticket here would be a second record of the same seam.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(a-stale-iou-reds) -> PROVED -> [SUPERSEDED]

watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: declared IOUs counted, referents that resolved, referents that could not be re-asked, and the escape population
watchme.consumer: CC at the build gate (a red is a finding to dispose) and Akien at the inbox when the escape population grows, because that is the shape that means the field is decoration
watchme.enough: fourteen days after PROVED with the stale count at zero AND the escape count not growing, or the first stale IOU caught by the sieve rather than by a hand census — which is the thing this ticket exists to make happen and stops the watch by succeeding
watchme.nexus: codemother's tree — a stale IOU is a care-of-the-code finding, and the escape count is the honest measure of whether the schema is being filled or gamed
watchme.trigger: every build_inspector pass — the sieve re-asks each declared IOU's referent and the probe counts two numbers: declared IOUs whose referent resolves (stale) and declared IOUs whose referent is the literal 'not expressible yet' escape
